data: Exactly 6 registered physical training terrains, each seat, two full independent natural 851c trajectories against original on each map-seat. Bind all 24 remote SHA-verified tapes, matched A/B receipts, official rules, initial terrain and 851c package. Preserve every win, draw, loss, unwitnessed opportunity and opponent clock. No labels from other batches. Candidate never sees full carbon, examiner private observations, search trace or sampled future.
derivative: Compute score gradient at the dequantized deployed 851c/510c student using its own ordinary observation history, residual safety route, legal prefix, native partner and two complete physical command options. Verify recorded issued order equals exactly one option, computed native softmax equals recorded propensity, signed Torch logit-gap error <=0.003 / probability error <=0.00075. Ordinary actions outside the sample menu and confirmed zero-support entries must match exports exactly. Natural RNG variate is unknown; never invent a draw to attest likelihood. Freeze partner, all auxiliary/value heads and serving code.
objective: For the two sibling trajectories i,j sharing terrain and learner seat, advantage A_i=U_i-U_j and A_j=-A_i. One score contribution A_i*grad log p_parent(actual order | menu, prefix) per genuine supported decision, signed both ways. Sum over both trajectories of all 12 pairs / (24*12), with unsupported/after-terminal opportunities zero. Both siblings enter; statistical unit is the map or 12 matched map-seat pairs, not 24 independent effects. No outcome filtering or clipping.
output: Single offline NumPy deployment carrying 851c natural OS-entropy initialization and the same 12 scheduled two-choice opportunities; only Sapling tensor fields may differ. Emit selected NPZ and deployable file plus SHA-256 and size, raw and quantized displacements, every trial data and actual callback differences. Distinguish training likelihood and independent game strength. No independent test or ladder qualification follows from an in-sample pass.
reward: Official termination / official extinction scoring. W=1 for win, 1/2 for draw, 0 for loss; U=0.5*W+0.5*sigmoid((own_official_score-other_official_score)/1000). A physical timeout, invalid record, missing reward or wrong package leaves this registered batch incomplete; no invented score or substitute maps.
scope: ONE preregistered training batch against unmodified original Master3s2; no additional original games, leaderboard or final examination are part of this learner. All prior tests, recent development matches and historical sparse roots excluded from fitting and candidate selection.
selection: Largest registered step for which (1) binary forward KL(parent||candidate) averaged over ACTUAL supported opportunities is finite and <=0.005; (2) sum A_i*(log p_candidate(chosen)-log p_parent(chosen))/288 is strictly positive; (3) compiled, physically legal natural deployment changes action or sampling probability in both seats. KL/scheduled also reported. For (3), on each seat at least one genuinely different legal free full order or >=1e-6 absolute probability change for a full physical order in the newly decoded natural menu (count commands as identities, include disappeared/new ones); report greedy-order flips, menu changes and pure probability shifts separately. The KL and logp primary quantities project onto the historical two commands, prefix and route; additionally report actual fresh natural menus and support coverage including lost chosen commands. Score near zero, exhausted viable steps, invalid prefix or incomplete required inputs means no qualified candidate.
update: Single ascent direction g/||g||_2, ordinary parameter addition, no Adam, value regression or extra fit iterations. Candidates all start from the same parent. Terminal step support and action probabilities must reproduce as served from 851c. Editable NPZ must re-quantize to its actual deployed student. Read back every exported package. All four fixed L2 trial sizes are evaluated on the exact 24 training tapes; retain all measurements. No below-grid retry.
